_doc: The ambush, on Darkness (song bars 88-120). With two stars awake the Stillness notices: it reaches for the Landing's light, and Orbin leads it away through the dark between the worlds, everything learned so far tested under pressure, the Stillness behind and around him, swallowing each place as he leaves it. Bars 0-3 at the Landing (it reaches); 4 the flight away to the debris bridge; 8-10 the Meteor, the first freeze (hold through it); 11 a flight to the twin wrecks (a figure-eight, the wave); 14 the first skip; 16 the drop: the great node, the surge, colour draining, flung to the dead moon; skips, freezes, the Meteor, jumps; 29 the escape: a long flight home over everything it has swallowed; 30-31 the Landing's light holds, the Kindlings close by the fire, Helion's signal pulses once.
Every bar is charted by hand (tools/journey.py from tools/journeys.py, then hand-tuned if need be). The id is the world's slot, not the song.
title: Darkness
adds: Everything so far, under pressure: freezes to hold through, skips on the beat

setpieces.name: It notices
setpieces.what: the Stillness rises over the Landing and reaches for its light; Orbin draws its eye

setpieces.name: Leading it away
setpieces.what: he throws himself off the Landing into the dark, a light to catch on the way, and it turns after him

setpieces.name: The first freeze
setpieces.what: a bar ahead, a stretch of the path darkens and starts to double; when it freezes, hold through it

setpieces.name: The wrecks
setpieces.what: a long flight to the twin wrecks, a figure-eight; the wave

setpieces.name: The skip
setpieces.what: the music skips and the path skips with it, on the beat: tap and you are thrown on, your double left behind

setpieces.name: The surge
setpieces.what: the drop: the great node, a beat of stillness, colour draining in waves, and the surge flings you to the dead moon

setpieces.name: The escape
setpieces.what: the long flight home over everything it has swallowed, two lights to catch

setpieces.name: The light holds
setpieces.what: the Landing's light holds; the Kindlings close by the fire; Helion's signal pulses once, clearly
